title: Implement Go health endpoints
objective: Buat endpoint liveness/readiness terpisah untuk layanan business-api, dengan tes untuk layanan sehat dan DB tidak tersedia.
forbidden_changes: public API contracts other than health
implementation_steps: Inspect current Go module and routing style; do not assume router library
Add tests for GET /health/live and GET /health/ready including unavailable DB
Implement smallest handlers and structured response
Run focused tests and report actual results
acceptance: Readiness returns unhealthy if DB is unavailable
No secret values are returned in health payload
evidence_required: Statement if Postgres integration was not tested
notes: Illustrative ticket: directory and commands planned, not currently runnable in blueprint-only package.
